History

Skin Upgrades

The Minigunner has thirty six skins in total. These include:

  1. The Default skin.
  2. Nineteen skins that can be unlocked from Crates.
  3. Two skins that can be unlocked from Codes.
  4. Two skins that can be unlocked from the Merch Shop.
  5. Two skins that can be unlocked from both Crates and Passes.
  6. Seven skins that can be unlocked from Passes.
  7. One skin that can only be obtained through the Daily Skin Store.
  8. One skin that can be unlocked from Mission Quests.
  9. One skin that can be unlocked from both Crates and Mission Quests.

Level Image Cosmetic Changes
0 Tan skin, black padded suit with red highlights, armored collar, grey kneepads, and black boots.

Wields an M134-A2 Gatling gun.

1 Black fingerless gloves with red strap and white knuckles, grey metal mouthpiece.
2 Mouthpiece extends into mask with four neon eyes.
3 Suit gains grey highlights and extra padding.

Now wields upgraded gatling railgun.

4 Posture change, mask extends to the sides and now has eight eyes, larger collar, grenades are strapped to torso, gatling gun is even bigger, and gains a hand guard.

The Sweaking skin is obtained from the Daily Skin Store.

Sweaking
Level Image Cosmetic Changes
0 Pale skin, blue buttoned shirt, purple suit with blue accents, purple backpack with yellow accents, purple shoes and dark yellow belt with grey buckle.

Wields an grey and orange Gatling gun to attack enemies.

1 Dark purple gloves, orange and purple ammo bandolier and purple top hat with a dark blue flower, purple and blue feathers, and blue outline.
2 Golden shades with blue lens and yellow knee-pads with blue straps.
3 Purple and yellow vest and shoulder-pads.

Now wields a larger grey, red and orange Gatling gun.

4 Fire on top of the top hat.

Suit is now purple with yellow and blue accents, shirt and knee-pads straps are now yellow.

Top hat is now dark purple with a yellow outline and flower, and yellow and dark purple feathers.

Now wields a neon yellow Gatling gun. It now faces towards the ground a bit likely due to it being upgraded and more heavy.

The Trucker skin is obtained from the Deluxe Crate.

Trucker
Level Image Cosmetic Changes
0 Tan skin, red checkered shirt with grey buttons, blue pants, black and yellow shoes and straps, and red and white cap with a blue bill and the Paradoxum Games logo.

Wields a light grey and black M134-A2 Gatling gun with exhaust pipes to attack enemies.

1 Black gloves and ammo bandolier.
2 Black shades with blue lens and black and yellow headset.
3 Brown jacket with white fur and grey knee-pads and shoulder-pads.

Now wields a Vulcan M134 Gatling gun with exhaust pipes and a license plate.

4 Red, bandanna, pauldrons, grey truck vest with multiple flaming exhaust pipes, a large wheel on its back, a license place and red headlights.

Improved knee-pads.

Now wields a large truck themed Vulcan M134 Gatling gun with large exhaust muffler at the front. The M134 Gatling gun now faces towards the ground.

The Chad skin was obtained from the Premium Crate from 1st of April 2024 through 12th of April 2024.

Chad
Level Image Cosmetic Changes
0 Grey skin, black beard, hair and pants.

Muscular torso and arms, well toned face.

Wields a Vulcan M134-A2 Gatling gun to attack enemies.

1 Black gloves and rad glasses.
2 No change.

Level Image Cosmetic Changes

Skin Trivia

  • The Minigunner currently has the second most skins for a tower, the first being Commander with 39 skins.
  • The Minigunner is the most used tower on the game images and videos, such as thumbnails or trailers.
  • Prior to the 8th of August 2019, the Level 5 upgrade was a jetpack. Functionally, it performed the same as any other ground tower.
    • Despite being a flying tower, the hitbox of the Minigunner did not change with the jetpack. They could still be stunned by rocks from Tanks and shockwaves from the Gravekeeper.
  • Some of the features of the Minigunner were inspired by R2DA and R2D.
    • The Vulcan M61 Gatling Gun used by most skins of the Minigunner was first popularized by R2D's Minigun.
    • The original Wraith skin held the P90 from R2DA.
    • At Level 5, the original Heavy skin held two M249s from R2DA.
  • Older Golden skin appearances are heavily inspired by the appearance of Golden Commando from Tower Battles.
  • Before the 13th of October 2019, when the Minigunner was Level 2 or higher, its face changed from the Roblox default face to the Grr! face, despite the fact that the upgrade icons kept the Roblox default face.
  • The concept for the original version of the Black Ops skin was based on a concept made by Firedolphin2211.
  • Originally, the Level 5 Pumpkin skin eyes were glitched, meaning that they did not move with the Minigunner.
  • The Level 5 Toy minigun is based on the Dart Zone Scorpion blaster.
  • The Toy skin was based on the Army men plastic soldiers.
  • The Level 0-3 minigun used by the Golden skin is similar to the Brass Beast from Team Fortress 2.
  • The older versions of level Level 4 Toy, Twitter and Community skin armor is similar to the one used in the Halo series.
  • Due to the high reflectance of the Level 4 Frost skin's visor, it changes colour depending on the skybox.
  • Prior to the 17th of April 2022, the Level 4 upgrade for the Golden Minigunner was broken, as the stand for the minigun would not move with the minigun itself.
  • The Level 3-4 double-barreled Vulcan M61 that is held by the current Minigunner looks similar to the Candy Cane Miniguns from Arsenal.
  • The Heavy skin is based on various Power Armors from the Fallout series.
  • The Space Elite skin may draw inspiration from the Space Marines of Warhammer 40k, bearing resemblances to the Red Talons chapter.
  • The Community skin from level 1-4 resembles the Discord mascot Wumpus.
  • The Pumpkin skin currently has the most ways to obtain it; from the Halloween 2019 Crate, the Pumpkin Crate and the Halloween Crate, although you can only get it from the latter as of the Lunar Overture Event if you do not have old crates in your inventory.
  • The Level 4 Warlord minigun skin is similar to the Huo-Long Heater from Team Fortress 2.
  • The Level 0-3 Golden skin uses an animation that most other skins use at Level 4, most likely to show its superiority as it is the skin for the Golden Minigunner perk.
  • The Level 4 Xmas skin heavily resembles the RX-78-2 Gundam.
  • The Sweaking skin is based on ItzSweaking.
    • The Sweaking skin's minigun is loosely based on the control rod used by Utsuho Reiuji from Touhou Project.
  • The appearance of the reworked Default skin for the Minigunner appears to have been based on the Plushie skin's appearance, with the skin predating the rework.
    • This is may be the case because of the Minigunner rework being planned months before it was actually added, which is supported by the Ducky skin using its current Level 4 minigun in the Duck Hunt Update thumbnail instead of the dual laser minigun and the matchmaking statue having a different Default skin model than the actual Default skin, reusing the Ducky skin's assets.
  • The Minigunner was expected to get a King skin for those who had bought VIP, though it has yet to be added in.
  • Upon release Bunny skin used the same placement sound as the Xmas Minigunner skin.
  • The Gardener skin's gatling guns are a reference to various plants in the Plants vs. Zombies franchise.
    • The Level 0-1 gatling gun is based on the Peashooter.
    • The Level 2-4 gatling gun is based on the Gatling Pea.

Roblox Catalog

  • A retextured version of the Elite Space Trooper is used by some skins at Level 4, and previously, Level 5.
  • The Level 4 paintball helmet that was present on some Minigunner skins was a re-textured version of the Deluxe Paintball Helmet accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • The Goggles, Bandolier and the Jetpack were also Roblox items which were originally used by the Default skin.
  • The Level 0-3 Pumpkin head is similar to the Sinister P. accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • The Level 4 head is similar to the Sinister M. accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The minigun wielded by the version 1 and 2 Xmas skin is the Candy Cane Launcher limited item from the Roblox catalog.
  • The version 1 and 2 Level 5 Black Ops paintball mask is the Black Paintball Mask accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • The version 1 and 2 Level 5 Black Ops beret is a re-textured version of the Redwood Prison Green Beret accessory from the Roblox catalog.
    • The Level 2-3 Black Ops goggles are the Spy Vision 7500 accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 2-4 Wraith goggles are a re-textured version of the Laser Spec Special Forces Goggles accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The version 1 and 2 Level 5 Twitter skin cap is a re-textured version of the Green Military Winter Cap, but with a twitter logo instead of a paradoxum logo.
    • This accessory was added way after the Twitter skin was added.
    • The Level 4 helmet used by these skins is a re-textured version of the Juggernaut's Helmet accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 4 helmet used by the Hazmat is a re-textured version of the The Bug Stomper accessory from the Roblox catalog.
  • The Level 3-4 skull shoulder pads used by the Pumpkin skin are the The Riddling Skull accessory from the Roblox catalog.
